name: smwmusic-the-vast-strickening-frost
title: The Vast Strickening Frost
description:
Abandoned in a frozen wasteland, you find yourself enshrouded in nothing but a blanket of biting wind and ice. Will you be able to forge a path through this pristine, lifeless, biome?

This song was the winning musical entry of Battle of the Bits' Winter Chip XX contest. Not really sure how that happened but I'll take it.
